subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should the new persisted camera-facing setting control every future iOS camera node command that omits `facing`, or should it be scoped more narrowly to Talk-driven capture behavior?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the implicit camera default through a persistent user preference; code review cannot determine the desired product scope for future agent capture commands.

options.title: Adopt the global preference
options.body: Keep the current behavior, with the user-selected facing becoming the default for all iOS camera commands that omit an explicit facing value.

options.title: Scope it to Talk
options.body: Revise the state flow so the camera toggle affects only the intended Talk interaction and leaves unrelated node-command defaults unchanged.

recommendation.title: Adopt the global preference
recommendation.body: Keep the current behavior, with the user-selected facing becoming the default for all iOS camera commands that omit an explicit facing value.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence shows this contributor owns the proposed iOS interaction and can clarify its intended user-facing scope.
